name: farm-profile-start-failure-recovery
description: Methodology for diagnosing and recovering from farm_profile_start failures using only the registered farm MCP tools. Covers HTTP errors and unparseable ('[object Object]') response bodies, container and image problems, profile state conflicts, missing or malformed profile ids, and transient provider failures.

principles.name: observe-before-action
principles.description: Always check farm status and profile state before attempting recovery actions to avoid compounding errors.

principles.name: isolate-failure-domain
principles.description: Determine if failure is profile-specific, farm-wide, or infrastructure-related by checking multiple profiles and system health.

principles.name: use-shared-state-for-coordination
principles.description: Leverage farm_state_get/set to coordinate recovery across containers and avoid race conditions during re-expansion.

principles.name: prefer-graceful-stop-over-force
principles.description: When profile is in unknown state, stop gracefully before restart rather than forcing start on potentially corrupted state.

principles.name: minimal-state-change
principles.description: Use farm_profile_stop, farm_profile_pause or farm_state_set only after the current state has been confirmed.

heuristics.condition: farm_status shows farm posture degraded or containers unhealthy
heuristics.action: Check farm_state_get for coordination flags, then restart the affected profiles sequentially, starting each only after farm_profiles shows the previous one running

heuristics.condition: The error names a specific container id
heuristics.action: Use farm_state_get to read the container mapping, then farm_command to issue the container-specific recovery command, and read farm_result to confirm it was accepted before retrying farm_profile_start

heuristics.condition: Farm status or state shows paused, stopped, or mismatched profile
heuristics.action: Use farm_profile or farm_state_set to reconcile the state, then retry farm_profile_start.

heuristics.condition: farm_profile_start fails with class farm and post /profiles/profile_#/start
heuristics.action: Check farm_status and farm_profiles, then use farm_command or farm_state_set to route the start and read farm_result to confirm it was accepted.

heuristics.condition: A start fails and the container id is known
heuristics.action: Log the container id with the failure and do not retry until the id is resolved or confirmed dead.

decision_rules.name: rule 0
decision_rules.condition: farm status and state indicate the profile is stopped or idle and no container or registry error is present
decision_rules.outcome: use farm_state_get, farm_profile, farm_state_set, and farm_profile_start in sequence

decision_rules.name: rule 1
decision_rules.outcome: Call farm_status to assess farm-wide health before profile-specific actions

requires.name: farm_status
requires.purpose: Get overall farm posture and per-farm health metrics

decision_rules.name: rule 2
decision_rules.condition: farm_status shows farm healthy but start failed
decision_rules.outcome: Call farm_profiles to see all profile states and identify conflicts

requires.name: farm_profiles
requires.purpose: List all farm profiles with stripped secrets to inspect states

decision_rules.name: rule 3
decision_rules.condition: Target profile shows 'running', 'starting', or 'paused' in farm_profiles
decision_rules.outcome: Call farm_profile_stop on the target profile, confirm with farm_profiles that it shows stopped, then retry farm_profile_start

requires.name: farm_profile_stop
requires.purpose: Gracefully stop a farm profile before restart attempt

requires.name: farm_profiles
requires.purpose: Confirm the profile shows stopped before the retry

decision_rules.name: rule 4
decision_rules.outcome: Call farm_state_get to read coordination flags and container mappings

requires.name: farm_state_get
requires.purpose: Read farm shared state for coordination flags and container mappings

decision_rules.name: rule 5
decision_rules.outcome: Call farm_profile on target profile for detailed state

requires.name: farm_profile
requires.purpose: Get detailed single farm profile state

decision_rules.name: rule 6
decision_rules.condition: Multiple profiles need sequential restart after farm-wide issue
decision_rules.outcome: Use farm_state_set to write recovery coordination flags preventing concurrent starts

requires.name: farm_state_set
requires.purpose: Write farm shared state for recovery coordination

decision_rules.name: rule 7
decision_rules.condition: The failure involves container image pull or registry authentication
decision_rules.outcome: Read the stated cause with farm_status and farm_result and report it, with the container and profile ids, to the operator. The registered farm tools do not pull images or hold registry credentials, so do not retry the start until the cause is addressed.

requires.name: farm_result
requires.purpose: Read the Command Center RESULT record

decision_rules.name: rule 8
decision_rules.condition: farm_profile_start returns a response body that is '[object Object]' or otherwise unparseable
decision_rules.outcome: Do not extract fields from that body. Probe the endpoint again with farm_status: if it answers with valid JSON, retry farm_profile_start once farm_profiles shows the profile is not running; if every probe keeps returning unparseable bodies, mark the start permanently failed, do not retry, and record the profile id and the request path for the operator.

requires.name: farm_profiles
requires.purpose: Confirm the profile is not running before the retry

decision_rules.name: rule 9
decision_rules.condition: farm_profile_start fails because the profile_id is missing, empty or malformed
decision_rules.outcome: Do not retry with the same value and do not guess, derive or alter another id. Compare the value with the profile ids farm_profiles lists; if farm_state_get shows the coordination flags or container mapping for this container naming exactly one listed profile, use that one; otherwise halt this start and surface the offending value, the container id and the error history to the operator.

requires.name: farm_profiles
requires.purpose: List the profile ids that exist

requires.name: farm_state_get
requires.purpose: Read coordination flags and container mappings

decision_rules.name: rule 10
decision_rules.condition: farm_profile_start fails with a transient error (timeout, connection reset, provider unavailable)
decision_rules.outcome: Retry with an increasing wait, carrying the original error and the attempt number forward; when the same error comes back unchanged after a retry and the farm shows no change, treat it as a permanent failure and surface it to the operator.

requires.name: farm_status
requires.purpose: Check whether the farm state changed between retries

decision_rules.name: rule 11
decision_rules.outcome: Surface the full error context (original payload, attempt number, error class, offending value) to the operator and keep the container in its current coordination state until the operator acknowledges; do not advance to the next coordination phase.

decision_rules.name: rule 12
decision_rules.condition: farm_profile_start fails for one profile while farm_profiles shows the other profiles unaffected
decision_rules.outcome: Continue with the other profiles and set the failed one aside for recovery; resolve each profile independently so a failure in one does not block or cascade into the rest.

decision_rules.name: rule 13
decision_rules.condition: A container id is present in the failure context but no earlier step has resolved it
decision_rules.outcome: Resolve the container id first with farm_state_get (container mappings) before retrying the profile start.
